paper_title: First Axion-Like Particle Results from a Broadband Search for Wave-Like Dark Matter in the 44 to 52 $μ$eV Range with a Coaxial Dish Antenna
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted (axis multiplier x10^-11)
notes: First ALP dish-antenna search (GigaBREAD) covering 44-52 ueV (10.7-12.5 GHz). The paper does not provide a table of g_agamma limit values; the exclusion curve is only shown in Fig. 3. The emitted coupling values are rough estimates based on Eq. 2 signal scaling and typical room-temperature dish-antenna sensitivity; actual limit likely ~1e-10 GeV^-1 level but should not be trusted quantitatively without the figure data. Mass range 44-52 ueV = 4.4e-5 to 5.2e-5 eV. rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3, B=3.9 T. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.82, 34)) | Vision: Panel (a) shows the GigaBREAD ALP-photon limit from 44-52 ueV on a linear y-axis (x10^-11).
